note: Both arms read the repositories at one path -- the MCP arm's git server reads the image's own /data/repos in the run's container, and each mirage /data/repos mount is a copy of one taken out of the same image; no tool this task enables reads the rest of /data. The repositories under repos/ are the clones upstream's image makes, at upstream's commits. GitHub is mirage's GitHub fake on both arms, and it holds nothing. Airtable is the fake both arms read, seeded per run with the base Atlas shares in place of an export.

cases.name: list_tables
cases.why: the same nine tables, and the same fields in the one the answer reads

cases.name: search_records
cases.why: one field searched, the same records; `grep .` fails either arm that finds nothing, so two empty searches cannot agree

mcp.pipe: jq -r '.[] | select(.fields.Date == "2023-Q1" and .fields["Employee Status"] == "Left") | .fields.Department + " " + (.fields["Employee Count"] | tostring)' | sort | grep .

cases.name: get_issue
cases.why: neither arm finds the issue live GitHub holds: both read the one fake, which holds nothing

cases.name: search_issues
cases.why: both arms are refused a search of a repository the fake does not hold, in GitHub's words

mirage.command: gh api search/issues -X GET -f 'q=repo:theonion/fartscroll.js created:2014-09-22' 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.errors[].message'

cases.name: git_log
cases.why: the local clone has the same history on both arms, which is where the second commit is counted
